title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Chases Irish Open History
items.text: Rory McIlroy returns as defending leader at the $6 million Amgen Irish Open, aiming to make history with his title defense.

items.headline: Irish Open Faces Scheduling Clash
items.text: The DP World Tour’s Irish Open runs the same weekend as the 2026 Solheim Cup, a scheduling move that disappoints many including fans and players.

items.headline: Korn Ferry Tour Finals Underway
items.text: The Simmons Bank Open starts the Korn Ferry Tour Finals with a strong field competing for PGA Tour cards and a $270,000 first prize.
